previous.description:
CodeMap is a Roslyn-powered MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that turns any MCP-compatible AI agent into a semantic code navigator for C#, VB.NET, and F# solutions.

Instead of reading source files, agents call 29 focused MCP tools to query symbols, call graphs, type hierarchies, architectural facts, and explicitly scoped repository diagnostics — directly from a Roslyn-built semantic index stored in memory-mapped binary segments (v2 engine, zero native DLL dependencies). Mixed-language solutions (.sln / .slnx containing both C# and VB.NET projects) are indexed in a single pass.

Average token savings: 90%+ vs raw file reading. On production codebases: 95–99%+.

Key capabilities:
- md_cs_mp_symbols_search / md_cs_mp_symbols_get_card / md_cs_mp_symbols_get_context — find and understand any symbol
- md_cs_mp_graph_trace_feature — full annotated feature flow in one call
- md_cs_mp_refs_find / md_cs_mp_graph_callers / md_cs_mp_graph_callees — precise reference and call chain navigation
- md_cs_mp_codemap_summarize / md_cs_mp_codemap_export / md_cs_mp_index_diff — codebase overview and semantic PR diffs
- Workspace mode — see uncommitted edits via incremental overlay (~63ms refresh)
- Repository-local cache by default (.codemap), with explicit data-root override via CODEMAP_DATA_DIR

Usage: add 'charpcodemap' as an MCP server in your AI agent config. See README for setup.

A cross-branch state cache for Git repositories. Answers, for a set of paths, which monitored branches carry changes a client does not have and what content they carry, using only git over HTTPS so it behaves identically against GitHub and Azure DevOps. Maintains a bare blobless mirror per repository, serves blob ids from a merge-base keyed diff cache, and performs every upstream operation with the requesting client's own credential. Ships as a dotnet tool and as a container image for Kubernetes.

previous.description: A caching reverse proxy for the Git LFS HTTP API. Relays every Batch API call upstream so upstream remains the sole authority on access, rewrites the returned transfer URLs to point at itself, and serves object bytes from a local content-addressed store. A cache miss is fetched from upstream once and stored on the way through, so the next request for that object is local. Ships as a dotnet tool and as a container image for Kubernetes.
